summary: st --attach draws an SVG's text in any installed font when the font it names is missing, instead of leaving the text out

replay.detail: No replay or rebuild; the change is in the CLI before upload.

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or triggers.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules, retention and admission are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: CLI behaviour: an SVG attached with --attach or st blobs put draws text whose font-family no installed font matches (including the default Times New Roman and the generic sans-serif) in an installed font, where it was left out before; with no fonts at all, an SVG with text is refused. No wire, client or harness contract change.

recovery.detail: Nothing to recover; rolling back the binary restores the previous rendering.
